expo.name: True Maps
expo.description: Navigate safer routes by avoiding reported road hazards in your area.

infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: True Maps uses your location in the background to provide turn-by-turn navigation and alert you to nearby hazards while driving.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: True Maps needs your location to show nearby hazards and help plan safe routes.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: True Maps uses the camera so you can take a photo of a road hazard — for example, snapping a pothole while reporting it — and to add photos to your car-parts marketplace listings.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: True Maps needs access to your photo library so you can attach an existing photo to a hazard report or a marketplace listing — for example, choosing a saved picture of a pothole or a part you're selling.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: True Maps needs your location to show nearby hazards and help plan safe routes.
